sections.title: Command Registry
sections.content: Defines red/green validation commands for canonical evidence, migration, bootstrap runtime, acceptance pipeline, projection/segmentation, semantic import, rollout regression, and terminal validation. Commands bind acceptance IDs, fixed programs, repository paths, and timeouts. Terminal coverage requires all listed green behavior programs; no command authorizes lifecycle publication.

sections.title: Requirements And Acceptance
sections.content: Defines ARBE-001 through ARBE-022 and acceptance criteria ARBE-A01 through ARBE-A46. Core requirements cover identity-bound admission, complete changed sets and typed closure, real checks and legal routes, isolated role and verifier behavior, immutable range projections and segment identities, process/lease retry policy, cost decisions, current Bootstrap import, shared canonical evidence and migrations, historical replay, telemetry/rollout gates, and a fixed supervised/unattended route matrix. Acceptance authority remains exclusive to Acceptance; Bootstrap and advisory Web Sol material carry no authorization.
